result.paraphrase: ADATA XPG GAMMIX S50 Gen4 internal M.2 2280 SSD, model AGAMMIXS50-1TT-C, with 1TB capacity and 3D TLC NAND. Uses PCI-Express 4.0 x4 and is intended for consumer use. Performance is rated at up to 4700 MB/s sequential read via ATTO, 5000 MB/s in CDM (QD32-T1), and 4100 MB/s in AS SSD; sequential write reaches 4200 MB/s via ATTO, 4400 MB/s in CDM (QD32-T1), and 3700 MB/s in AS SSD. Offers up to 750,000 IOPS for 4KB random read and write, 1,700,000-hour MTBF, a heatsink, PCIe 4.0 support, NVMe 1.3, advanced LDPC ECC, SLC caching with DRAM cache buffer, and AES 256-bit encryption. Compact gaming- and high-end-desktop-friendly design, 50 mW idle power, 0.8W active power, 0°C to +70°C operating temperature, -40°C to +85°C storage temperature, and 1500G/0.5 ms shock resistance. Measures 6.10 mm high, 22.00 mm wide, 80.00 mm deep, weighs 12.00 g, and was first available on October 07, 2019.
